description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of six distinct categories based on their respective counts, with the largest segment being “chat” at 41.2% (546,526 instances), followed by “math” at 21.9% (290,496). The “tooluse” category accounts for 11.6% (154,358), while “multi turn chat” represents 9.3% (123,615). “Code” comprises 9.0% (119,563), and “instruction follow” makes up the smallest portion at 6.9% (91,460). Each category is color-coded and labeled with both its name and percentage, and a legend in the top-left corner matches colors to categories with their raw counts. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of “chat” and “math” over the other categories, which are more evenly distributed in smaller proportions.
